scope: Only jsonapi-symfony. External acceptance verification is reserved for the user after branch installation.

gaps.root_cause_and_change: Write preconditions were evaluated after processor persistence; now current representation is checked at kernel.controller before writes.
gaps.previous_bundle_coverage: Existing PreconditionsOnWritesTest inspected HTTP status after mutation; no database-state guarantee.
gaps.acceptance_result: not run: user requested bundle-only implementation and separate branch validation

gaps.root_cause_and_change: Resolver ignored configured entity timestamp; document carries current models and timestamp field/per-type configuration is used.
gaps.previous_bundle_coverage: Existing cache tests did not compare Last-Modified to persisted entity timestamp.
gaps.acceptance_result: not run: user requested bundle-only implementation and separate branch validation

gaps.root_cause_and_change: Missing ref/href blocked canonical creation; infer collection from data.type.

gaps.acceptance_result: not run: user requested bundle-only implementation and separate branch validation
